Initial release of the smyx-seed-germination-rate-prediction-analysis skill.

- Enables AI-powered analysis of seedling tray images or videos to predict seed germination rate.
- Supports emergence detection, germinated seed counting, and comparison to sown total.
- Handles user image/video uploads and automated processing for various growing scenarios.
- Includes strict open-id acquisition and verification flow before analysis can proceed.
- Provides history querying and results as markdown tables with direct report links.
- Enforces accurate data retrieval and reporting via API, disallowing local report aggregation.
